format: Direct native SR, checked computation insertion
scope: Untrusted proof producer; complete canonical certificates, not an arithmetic oracle

cases.name: SR0_nonzero_seed
cases.meaning: SR zero computation returns the successor of a nonzero initializer.

cases.name: SRS_state_used
cases.meaning: The successor update actually uses the recursive state.

cases.name: SRS_constant_update
cases.meaning: A constant update still requires a valid recursive predecessor image.

cases.name: SR_reflexivity_from_positive_computation
cases.meaning: Reflexivity derives from R(1,0;const t)=t and transport.

cases.name: SR_actual_atomic_induction
cases.meaning: Literal equation induction uses its induction hypothesis and SRS.

cases.name: SR_Q_compound_target
cases.meaning: Closure specialization at a compound term, with the actual SR base.

cases.name: SR_compound_case_nested_induction
cases.meaning: Compound case introduction retains an outer parameter for nested atomic induction.

cases.name: SR_nonvacuous_D_Q_roundtrip
cases.meaning: A nonvacuous witness is opened, used in a closure, and discharged.

cases.name: SR_transport_under_Q
cases.meaning: Equality transport changes an initializer below a Q binder.

cases.name: SR_Boolean_decoder_native_CASE
cases.meaning: Closed Q_x[p2(S(Zx))=Zx], derived by native case introduction and finite SR computations.

cases.name: SR_Boolean_decoder_specialization
cases.meaning: The native decoder closure is specialized with a separately proved zero case.

cases.name: SR_restricted_Boolean_implication
cases.meaning: A nested native D implication cancels successor only on a variable Boolean, using the checked decoder.

cases.name: SR_reject_compound_progress
cases.meaning: A forged compound induction step needs Q at z; the actual rule supplies only Q at zero.

cases.name: SR_reject_old_I0
cases.meaning: The old zero-initialized computation is false: SR(0,0;0)=1, not0.

cases.name: SR_reject_false
cases.meaning: A genuine SR computation does not prove0=1.

cases.name: SR_reject_missing_seed
cases.meaning: A constant update cannot hide an invalid seed.

cases.name: SR_reject_two_child_counter
cases.meaning: A two-child counter is not a successor.

cases.name: SR_reject_three_child_counter
cases.meaning: A three-child counter cannot pass the eager predecessor-shape check.

cases.name: SR_reject_future_goal_parameter
cases.meaning: Closed goals cannot contain unallocated parameter labels.

cases.name: SR_reject_arity_four
cases.meaning: The sorted codec rejects arity four.

cases.name: SR_reject_failed_major
cases.meaning: A false major cannot fall through into an otherwise valid computation.

cases.name: SR_reject_BI_without_zero_assumption
cases.meaning: The Boolean implication proof needs its actual zero-case antecedent, not a progress assumption.

cases.name: SR_reject_shifted_decoder_target
cases.meaning: The valid Boolean decoder proof cannot prove its false successor-shifted target.

cases.name: SR_reject_unallocated_DI_witness
cases.meaning: A D witness cannot name a future parameter.

cases.name: SR_reject_case_instead_of_induction
cases.meaning: The induction proof needs E(z), not only E(0).

cases.name: SR_reject_unallocated_Q_target
cases.meaning: A Q specialization cannot name a future parameter.
